03 · DEVELOPER TOOLSIN PROGRESS

Database migration workbench

A Python web application that compares an existing SQLite database with a target schema and generates executable migration plans.

I implemented merge-sort-based schema comparison, native SQLite changes and transactional table rebuilds, with dry runs, destructive-change detection, row-count verification, and integrity checks.
